import unittest
from unittest.mock import Mock
from flight_faults import isolate_payload_bus


class PayloadBusFaultTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_overcurrent_disables_payload_bus_once(self):
        power_switch = Mock()

        tripped = isolate_payload_bus(2.4, 2.0, power_switch)

        self.assertTrue(tripped)
        power_switch.disable.assert_called_once_with("payload_bus")

    def test_current_at_limit_does_not_disable_payload_bus(self):
        power_switch = Mock()

        tripped = isolate_payload_bus(2.0, 2.0, power_switch)

        self.assertFalse(tripped)
        power_switch.disable.assert_not_called()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
